name: saas-demand-radar
description: SaaS Demand Radar - discover which SaaS products people want from public X and Reddit conversations

scripts.start: npm run db:migrate && npm run build && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run api" "npm run web:serve"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run api:watch" "npm run web:dev"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
